title: Top K Frequent Elements
statement:
Given an integer array nums and an integer k, return the k most frequent elements. You may return the answer in any order.

You are required to solve the problem in better than O(n log n) time complexity.
constraints: k is in the range [1, the number of unique elements in the array]

visibleExamples.explanation: The element 1 appears 3 times, 2 appears 2 times, and 3 appears 1 time. The two most frequent elements are 1 and 2.
The element 1 appears 3 times, which is the most frequent. Return [1].
There is only one element with frequency 1, so the answer is [1].
